reviews.text: Please be cautious when dropping your dog off and leaving them in the care of certain groomers or bathers at Pet Bar. In my experience, incidents involving pets are not always properly documented or communicated to the owner. I believe pet parents should be informed anytime something happens while their dog is in someone else’s care.
Cut my dog badly even if was accident, I believe more training can prevent this

I have taken my dog to many places to get her nails trimmed and Petbar is by far superior in every way. The staff is caring welcoming. They are very gentle with my dog. And they are unbelievably fair price wise. Well worth the drive to get here.
They charge you for everything but with horrible results 😡

It was our first time, my puppy is 5months and I was very afraid to have his hair cut but she nailed it.  Super clean ears, nail trim, and baby cologne.  Perfect.  Thank you so much!  we will be back.

I had the best experience at Petbar Aventura! This was my very first time using a self-service dog wash, and the staff made me feel so comfortable from the moment I walked in. They took the time to show me everything I needed to know and explained how to use all of the equipment.

They had all the proper tools and products to make bathing my dog so easy and stress-free. By the time we were done, my dog looked like a brand new dog! It was such a great experience.

The only suggestion I have is to add non-slip mats to the drying tables. My dog was sliding around a bit, which made drying a little more challenging. It wasn’t a huge issue at all—just something that could make an already great experience even better.

Overall, I will definitely continue coming here, and I highly recommend Petbar Aventura to anyone looking for a clean, convenient, and friendly place to bathe their dog. Whether it’s your first time or you’re a regular, this is an amazing self-service dog wash!
Great people. Great. Service

I brought my little Chihuahua in for grooming because his legs are so tiny that I’m too nervous to trim his nails myself. I paid $45 for a bath, ear cleaning, and a nail trim. I don’t usually write reviews, but I was so upset and disappointed by this experience that I felt I had to.

I explained multiple times exactly how I wanted my dog groomed and specifically asked them not to touch her tail. Unfortunately, the groomer completely ignored my instructions and shaved her so much that I could barely recognize my own dog afterward.

What upset me even more was the way the situation was handled after I complained. Nobody apologized or showed any understanding. I was simply told that the manager would call me, but I never received a call.

Mistakes can happen, but the lack of communication, accountability, and basic customer care made this experience even worse.
What an awesome pet grooming spa 💗💕🩷 My little Luna loved it and so did I 🐶 God Bless you all we will see you again soon 💗💕🩷💗🩷💕 …

Disappointed and concerned, won’t take my puppy there ever again. Be careful with your pets if you decide to go there.

After his appointment my dog ended limping of one leg and lost his appetite completely, hasn’t eaten in 3 days and looks in pain. I took my 8 month (Irish cream) Golden Retriever on 02/25/2026 at 3:30PM for Full wash, sanitary trim, ear cleaning and teeth cleaning.

When I picked him up he looked fine, I didn’t notice anything off with him, but when we got home he only wanted to sleep and was looking really sad, didn’t eat. I thought he was just tired from the grooming. Next day I noticed he was CLEARLY limping, didn’t eat the whole day and was very low mood, this continued for the next days until today 4 days after finally was able to eat something.

It is clear to me that something happened during his appointment because he couldn’t have been hurt anywhere else and he is a very dócil and scared puppy. Doesn’t bite, is not aggressive so I have no clue how this could have happened, if it was an accident or not we will never know, but definitely not taking any chances taking him there ever again.

The person that took care of him was rough and somehow he ended up hurt, limping and scared. If I was the owner of this place I would want to review the video footage to check to see if this was an accident or if there’s someone there who mistreats or harms dogs.

This place is full of scammers. I went to get my dogs bathed, and they told me they didn't have time for both of them. Then they asked if I could leave them. After 40 minutes, they called to say they were ready. Two dogs can't be bathed and groomed in such a short time. When I got home, they smelled fine, and I paid for the service, leaving a 15% tip. When I got home, I took them out and checked them. They weren't bathed; they still had the same matted fur, even the grass that was stuck to their paws and whiskers was still there. I called to talk about it, and no one knew anything. They said the manager would call, but they never did. Today I called again, and a super rude and arrogant girl hung up on me. If you're in this area, never go to this place. They mistreat animals and charge you for a service they don't provide, and then they hang up on you. DO NOT BRING YOUR DOGS HERE.

I’m really disappointed with the experience I had here. This wasn’t my dog’s first time getting groomed at this location, but it will definitely be the last. Right when it was time for me to pick her up, I got a text saying there were “some knots” and that it would be an extra $10 to remove them — even though I sat and combed her myself before dropping her off.

What really bothered me is that no one offered any kind of explanation, apology, or even tried to talk to me about it when I got there. It honestly just felt petty and unprofessional. You would expect a grooming service to take care of small things like that without trying to charge extra, especially when it wasn’t even a real issue. Definitely won’t be coming back.

My first time at petbar. I was really nervous because I love💘 my beautiful Morkie and wanted mostly that he be cared for humanly. He had been with a wonderful groomer at a Vets office since he was born 9.5 years ago but she fell ill so I could not get him groomed with her. My baby Morkie's hair had grown so much. He gets a good cloth wash and brush twice a day, teeth brushed once a day and bath once every other week by me. But he needed hair and paw hair groom. So I read about petbar and great reviews, including their groomer Sarah. It was pleasant meeting Sarah and she seemed experienced and did a wonderful job...I hope my Morkie was good because he is sensitive about having his paws groomed. Given the great groom by Sarah it makes it easier to trust which is my number one and most important experience. Oh and the reception area reps were very nice and professional. Thank you to Sarah, and all.  Look forward to next visit. To the owners, please keep up the good work and building trust.  I would suggest more car parking...that would be great. All the best.
